name: Drygulch Ravine
summary: Dustwind harpies prey on supply caravans at Drygulch Ravine in eastern Durotar. Reach their rocky refuge through a cave from Razorwind Canyon or by a perilous leap from above.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven in the Red Rocks
sections.body: East of Orgrimmar, Drygulch Ravine lies sheltered among Durotar's rocky crags. A cramped natural tunnel from Razorwind Canyon is the only way in at ground level. Dustwind harpies roost along the steep cliffs, where they keep their broods and pile up goods stolen from Horde supply trains on the regional trails.

sections.title: A Thorn in Durotar's Side
sections.body: The Dustwind harpies are the ravine's chief danger. Their matriarchs fiercely guard eggs tucked along the high ledges. Horde scouts often send young warriors to thin the flock, recover stolen trade crates, and break the harpies' hold on the ravine.

faq.q: How do you get into Drygulch Ravine?
aliases: where is the cave to drygulch
faq.answer: You can reach the ravine by leaping from the high cliffs above, if you survive, or through the small cave entrance in neighboring Razorwind Canyon.

faq.q: What creatures live in Drygulch Ravine?
faq.answer: Dustwind harpies rule the ravine. They nest, lay eggs, and stash stolen caravan supplies along its craggy rock shelves.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this ravine?
faq.answer: Dustwind harpies raid Durotar's trade trails and hoard stolen cargo in the gorge. Authorities in Razor Hill regularly send recruits to recover provisions and thin the flock.

angles.text: Securing the harpies' roosts and recovering stolen supplies helps protect Durotar's trade routes from constant banditry.
As a young orc, you can prove your mettle against the fierce harpies perched on your homeland's rocky bluffs.
